gap.caveat: Counts are India-specific primary studies identified by this rapid review (PubMed, Europe PMC and Crossref; title/abstract search; open full texts only). A zero means no India-specific study was identified by this rapid review, not that none exists: the search cannot see global or multi-country studies whose India result appears only in the full text, paywalled reports that were not retrieved, or Scopus, Web of Science and Embase content.

prisma_note: PRISMA 2020: n_included counts studies; n_reports_included counts their reports (n_linked_reports further reports, e.g. preprints, are linked to an included study, not counted as full-text exclusions).
